notes: Starting cards as posted at the top of the list: Agents Of Black Sun, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; these count toward the 60. Prince Xizor is also listed again among the characters (both copies counted as posted).
Posted 'Prepared Defense' dested Prepared Defenses; 'Courscant' dested the Dark Special Edition Coruscant system; 'Courscant Docking Bay' dested the Dark Special Edition Coruscant: Docking Bay.
Posted 'Jabba's Palace Lower Corridor' dested Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages (the only Jabba's Palace site with a similar name).
Posted 'The Signal' x2 (a Light interrupt) dested its Dark counterpart Twi'lek Advisor; the strategy mentions starting 'Twi'lek and Presence Of The Force'.
Posted 'Tatooine Docking Bay 327' is printed as written: it could mean Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (the deck is built around Tatooine) or Death Star: Docking Bay 327.
Posted 'What Are You Tryin' To Push On Us' is printed as written: What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? is a Light card only.
The strategy says Sunsdown was later switched for Sunsdown & Too Cold For Speeders; the list keeps Sunsdown as posted.
